decisions.reason: Leaving ESP32 decoupling capacitors C18 and C19 in place does not change the standalone regulator, its capacity, source selection, or powered load.
The capacitor-placement decision does not change the monitored rails, monitoring IC, channel allocation, or measurement coverage.
ESP32 supply-decoupling placement is independent of the AXP2101 exposed-pad thermal requirement.
The decision about C18 and C19 does not alter the switched 5V rail, GPIO control, converter, or connected loads.
Leaving the ESP32 decoupling capacitors in their existing positions does not change the AXP2101 battery, USB, VMID, or VSYS power path.
The source decision does not affect the panel button connector, its board placement, signal connection, or control behavior.
The accepted capacitor placement does not modify the configured DCDC1 voltage or the required 3.3V rail regulation.
The ESP32 decoupling decision does not change trace-width or current-carrying requirements for VBUS, +5V, or BAT-.
The display backlight has a separate 4.7µF PWM-ripple capacitor; the source refers specifically to ESP32 capacitors C18 and C19.
The decoupling-capacitor placement decision has no effect on the battery connector series, pitch, pinout, or mounting type.
Although both concern the ESP32 area, leaving C18 and C19 in place does not alter the module model, pin breakout, hole placement, or header pitch.
Retaining two local capacitor positions does not necessarily change any recorded board dimensions, connector placement, ESP32 edge placement, or enclosure-layout rule.
